'''Oseon VII''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] that was a major tourist attraction and a center of exploration for the whole [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. [[Cix Trouvee|Trouvee]] family owned a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] complex on this planet. At one time, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] visited the planet.
